statements.statement: Several studies demonstrate the use of end-to-end neural networks for autonomous vehicle steering.
ALVINN showed that an end-to-end trained neural network can steer a car on public roads using a fully-connected network smaller than modern networks.

More recent work applies convolutional neural networks (CNNs) that learn the entire processing pipeline to steer an automobile, generating steering commands from single front-facing center camera images.
These networks are trained on diverse driving data including video from multiple cameras and steering commands, leveraging back propagation for weight adjustment.
